description.value: Valancy Stirling, an inhibited twenty-nine-year-old spinster, undergoes a total personality change when a doctor tells her she has no more than one year to live.

Valancy, 29 years old and never married, has never contradicted her overbearing mother and troublesome aunt. However, one fateful day a letter arrives from Doctor Trent, and Valancy decides she must do and say exactly what she wishes.
